label: Entry: install.sh
text: The entry script checks for uv, a tool installer that it needs for thefuck. It stops before shell setup if uv remains unavailable. [4] [5]

label: Detection: common.sh
text: The detector honors an existing MACHINE value. It derives the target home from SUDO_USER only if that variable exists. [6] [7]

label: Shell setup: zsh/install.sh
text: Without root access on Linux, it places Starship, lsd, and direnv in ~/.local/bin. The linked .zshenv adds that directory to the shell path. [8] [5] [9]

label: Global Git config
text: The installer sets init.defaultBranch=main and pull.rebase=true for the target user. It asks for missing name and email only during an interactive run. [10]
